[[File:Zombie axe detail.png|left|120px]]
The '''zombie axe''' is a one-handed [[Weapons/Categories#Axe|axe]] that requires 65 [[Attack]] to wield. It is created by taking a [[broken zombie axe]], obtained as a drop from [[armoured zombie]]s, to an anvil and repairing it with 70 [[Smithing]].

The axe's high strength bonus and slash attack stats are higher than any other one-handed weapon, while its crush attack bonus is only surpassed by the [[dragon warhammer]] and [[Inquisitor's mace]] (not counting PVP-only weapons). Despite its 5-[[RuneScape clock|tick]] attack speed, the axe performs better than the [[dragon scimitar]] and against enemies weak to crush or enemies with higher defence, such as a [[gargoyle]], the axe can deal even more average damage than an [[abyssal whip]]. This is particularly useful for midgame [[Ironman Mode|ironman players]] who do not have level 85 [[Slayer]] to kill [[abyssal demon]]s.

The zombie axe's slash bonus will always slash [[web]]s successfully like the [[Wilderness sword 1]], making it a convenient weapon for ironmen to slay [[Sarachnis]].

The zombie axe counts as an axe for fixing bridges when doing [[Temple Trekking]].
